verifications.claim: Netflix does not offer a free trial in 2026
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Netflix does not offer a free trial.' 'Is there a free Netflix code in 2026? ... Netflix does not offer free trials.'; R7: 'No, there is no Netflix free trial available in 2026.'; R2: 'Netflix does not offer any type of free trial.'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state no free trial in 2026 or currently, with explicit 2026 mentions in R1 and R7.

verifications.claim: Netflix discontinued the free trial program in October 2020
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'Netflix discontinued its standard free trials in the U.S. back in October 2020.'; R3: 'discontinued all free trials in the U.S. back in 2020'
verifications.reasoning: R6 directly specifies October 2020; R3 supports 2020 discontinuation.

verifications.claim: There are no official active trial periods for new or returning users in the U.S.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'Netflix does not currently offer trials of any length for new or returning subscribers.'; R2: 'Netflix does not offer any type of free trial.'; R3: 'discontinued all free trials in the U.S. back in 2020'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm no trials for new/returning users in U.S., with R6 explicit.

verifications.claim: Netflix users are required to pay immediately
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'select a subscription plan and make the required payment.'; R6: 'Payment details are required upfront to start your subscription.'; R5: signup process requires choosing plan and payment.
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe signup requiring immediate payment to access service.

verifications.claim: Netflix users can cancel at any time to avoid future charges
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'you can cancel whenever you want.'; R6: 'cancel your subscription before the next billing cycle.'; R3: 'navigate to Account > Cancel Membership'
verifications.reasoning: Direct statements across sources confirm cancel anytime to avoid future charges.

verifications.claim: Select plans from providers like T-Mobile or Verizon provide access to Netflix at no extra cost
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'T-Mobile’s “Netflix on Us” freebie'; 'Verizon’s Netflix + Max ... getting Netflix at no extra cost'; R2: 'perk on select Verizon plans'; R6: 'T-Mobile 'Netflix On Us' ... at no extra monthly cost.'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly name T-Mobile and Verizon plans providing Netflix at no extra cost.

verifications.claim: Netflix's website sometimes provides a selection of episodes from popular shows to stream for free
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: Sources mention free episodes on YouTube (R3, R6), not Netflix's website.

verifications.claim: Using a Netflix gift card allows for prepaid access without a continuous automatic subscription
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'gift card ... the amount will be added to your balance.' 'without any commitment.'; R6: 'pay for your subscription without committing to a recurring monthly charge. ... covering your monthly fee until it runs out.'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm gift cards provide prepaid balance without auto-recurring charges.

verifications.claim: Scams claiming to offer free trials are often fraudulent according to Spliiit
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1 (Spliiit): '“codes Netflix ” circulating on the internet are almost always scams'; 'if a website promises ... "a free Netflix trial," it is not an official Netflix offer.' '"Free Netflix code 2026": almost always a scam.'
verifications.reasoning: R1 from Spliiit directly calls free trial/code claims scams.

verifications.claim: The only official way to sign up for Netflix is through netflix.com/signup
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R4: 'done from your smartphone, tablet/iPad, computer, or directly on your smart TV. For smart TVs and Android devices, ... download and install the Netflix app.'; R6: 'by visiting the official Netflix website ... or by downloading the Netflix app'
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe multiple official signup methods (app, smart TV, website), contradicting 'only' netflix.com/signup.
